description: scopeWhereFor(entity, {allowed:true, scope, roles:[], anchors}, userId) — packages/api/src/access/entity-policies.ts. Returns the Prisma where-fragment for a narrow scope (own/team/unit), {} for organization/company, and throws FORBIDDEN for a narrow scope with no anchor loader. Asserted IDENTICALLY by the TS suite (real scopeWhereFor) and Tims.UnitTests (ScopeWhereFor.BuildAsync → ScopePredicate.ToJsonNode). anchors=null marks the FORBIDDEN cases. in-list order is significant.
